campaign.name: Affine 2BGA (Kasai) sweeps at n <= 684, check weights 8 and 12
campaign.notes: sample_kasai_affine is the only kit sampler whose n reaches the band the board's most efficient entries sit in (630..682); see the reach table in research/AUTORESEARCH.md. weight=6 -> check weight 12, weight=4 -> check weight 8, since check weight is 2*weight. Both sweeps rank candidates on a refined reading, because the coarse distance reading inflates d and efficiency goes as d^2. The gate decides every find.
